  {'id':'sequential_dot_coefficients','description':'Derive the exact coefficient expansion of the computed sequential dot product in terms of the original T row and the previously computed xhat entries.   {'id':'row_update_construction','description':'For each solved row with k >= 2, derive coefficient perturbations from the dot-product factors for off-diagonal entries and the reciprocal product of the subtraction and division factors for the diagonal entry. Prove its entries refer to the same original T, b, and computed xhat as in the algorithm. Establish triangularity and preservation of original zero entries through the relative coefficient bounds.'},
  {'id':'global_matrix_conclusion','description':'Convert every perturbed row identity into (T + DeltaT).mulVec xhat = b using finite sums, triangular zeros, and vector extensionality. For each active row use its number k of involved unknowns, k <= n, and gamma monotonicity to obtain the stated global componentwise gamma_n bound; show inactive entries satisfy it as well.'},
  {'id':'upper_case','description':'Complete backward substitution for upper triangular inputs, including the last row as the one-division base case. Either repeat the rowwise construction with k equal to the number of remaining unknowns, or prove a reversal equivalence for T, b, xhat, computation order, nonsingularity, matrix multiplication, and componentwise absolute bounds and transport the lower-triangular result. A bare without-loss-of-generality assertion is insufficient.'},
  {'id':'formal_validation_and_blockers','description':'Validate the complete Lean declarations against local Lean and Mathlib without custom axioms, sorry, placeholders, or unproved source helpers. Audit all hypotheses and the original-input linkage.  ]
}

        if os.path.exists(tmp): os.unlink(tmp)
print('Atomically saved /output/retrieval.json and /output/plan.json; plan has', len(plan['obligations']), 'obligations.')
